title: MCT response manifest
description: A's final assistant-facing content, by reference. Object kind 'response_body'/manifest. Design ref: §7.3, §8.6, §16. B validates digest, turn, epoch, policy before rendering exactly once (invariants 11, 14).

body.description: Pointer to the sealed response body object in the write-only outbox.

format.description: Rendered format. Terminal-escape injection is rejected unless explicitly supported (§16.3).

opened_context.description: Pointer to the context_receipt: what A actually opened (§12.2, invariant 6).

proposed_actions.description: Zero or more action_proposal pointers. An empty array is the default; side effects require the separate proposal flow (§13.5).

body_sha256.description: Digest of the complete response body; B verifies before commit (§16.2).
